```{=html}
<h1 class="visually-hidden">WOMBAT 2026 Schedule</h1>
<!-- Sticky Day Switcher -->
  <nav id="day-switcher">
    <button class="switcher-btn active" data-target="day-1-tutorials">
      <span class="switcher-btn-full">Day 1 Tutorials</span>
      <span class="switcher-btn-short">Day 1</span>
    </button>
    <button class="switcher-btn" data-target="day-2-workshop">
      <span class="switcher-btn-full">Day 2 Workshop</span>
      <span class="switcher-btn-short">Day 2</span>
    </button>
  </nav>
```

```{=html}
<script>
document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', () => {
      const buttons = document.querySelectorAll('.switcher-btn');
      const sections = Array.from(buttons)
        .map(btn => document.getElementById(btn.getAttribute('data-target')))
        .filter(Boolean);

      // 1. Smooth scroll to section when button is clicked
      buttons.forEach(btn => {
        btn.addEventListener('click', () => {
          const targetId = btn.getAttribute('data-target');
          const targetSection = document.getElementById(targetId);
          
          if (targetSection) {
            // Calculate position accounting for the fixed navbar (4.25rem / ~68px)
            // the day switcher now floats over, plus a little breathing room.
            const yOffset = -80;
            const y = targetSection.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.pageYOffset + yOffset;
            
            window.scrollTo({ top: y, behavior: 'smooth' });
          }
        });
      });

      // 2. Intersection Observer to highlight active section based on scroll position
      const observerOptions = {
        root: null,
        // Adjust bounds so that section registers as 'active' when it reaches upper middle of screen
        rootMargin: '-20% 0px -75% 0px', 
        threshold: 0
      };

      const observer = new IntersectionObserver((entries) => {
        entries.forEach(entry => {
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            // Remove active class from all
            buttons.forEach(btn => btn.classList.remove('active'));
            
            // Add active class to corresponding button
            const activeBtn = document.querySelector(`.switcher-btn[data-target="${entry.target.id}"]`);
            if (activeBtn) {
              activeBtn.classList.add('active');
            }
          }
        });
      }, observerOptions);

      sections.forEach(section => {
        observer.observe(section);
      });
    });
</script>
```
